answer: One credential per registered land parcel. Agents reporting terrace erosion must prove control of a parcel through a registry signature bound to their account and epoch. The verifier follows the ownership thread and marks that parcel's reward spent, even if its survey mentions onyx deposits. N accounts need N distinct parcels, requiring purchase or rental from owners. This assumes the registry rejects overlapping parcels and subdivision cannot increase the total reward for the same land area.
